basis: The 'Monthly Reservoir Release Volume' chart shows that the release volume for May is extremely low, appearing as a very short bar near the bottom of the y-axis (well below 10,000 m3). This is a significant outlier compared to all other months shown (Jan, Feb, Mar, Apr, Jun), which all have volumes between roughly 17,000 and 40,000 m3. This drastic drop indicates a critical anomaly rather than a standard low-release case.
option_label: Escalate May to critical low-release anomaly review
